title: Time Jump: 15:20 — HCC Level 2 Activated

fields.narration: It is now 15:20 on Thursday, March 12, 2026. The Hospital Incident Command Center (HCC) is operating at Level 2. The vendor account pumplink-support has been blocked, and ORRMC-PUMP01 is no longer pushing configurations. Eleven of the 22 high-alert pumps have been swapped. The central telemetry display on ORRMC-MON01 still shows four beds in ICU 3 North as blank. The pump manufacturer’s security desk is on the line, awaiting contact.
worldState: The HCC is active at Level 2.
The vendor session broker ORRMC-VSB01 has blocked the account pumplink-support.
ORRMC-PUMP01 is no longer pushing updates.
Eleven of the 22 high-alert pumps have been physically swapped to 4.2.1.
The central telemetry display continues to show four beds in ICU 3 North as unresponsive.
The pump manufacturer's security team is calling back for further information.
fields.facilitatorNote: This time jump advances the exercise to a stable but still high-risk state. The technical team has mitigated active propagation, but the clinical team must now decide on long-term recovery, reporting, and family communication. Watch for delays in declaring full activation or escalating to Level 1.
fields.scenarioTitle: Ghost Pumps — Infusion Pump Integrity and Clinical Trust

instructorNote: This time jump advances the incident to a stabilized but critical state. The technical team has stopped the attack vector, but the clinical team must now decide on recovery, reporting, and family disclosure. Watch for whether the CNO or AOC pushes for full activation or delays escalation.
